Number of studies.evidence_source: Women were also asked on separate question about their reason for weight loss with six options (to look better, for easier movement, to be healthier, to be able to wear a wider range of clothes, because of family or friends' comments, and to be sexier) to know more about the main reason that can influence women to lose weight.

section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the background variables collected (age, marital status, education, work status, household income, children) and multiple instruments: Body Appreciation measured with the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) translated to Arabic, BMI measured by trained nutritionists using digital scales and stadiometers, body weight satisfaction (satisfied/dissatisfied), weight-loss efforts (10-point items classified into tried/not tried), reasons for weight loss, and media use. The section provides reliability (α=0.81 for BAS; α=0.76 for weight-loss items) and categorisation for BMI (normal, overweight, obese).
section_summary.evidence_source: BA: This was measured by the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), developed by Avalos L et al., [6]. BMI: Weight (taken on digital scales) and height (taken on stadiometers) were measured by the trained nutritionists using standardised protocols. The internal consistency (reliability) of the items was α=0.81 (BAS) and α=0.76 (WL items).
